definitions.explanation: Decorative items made with precious metals and gemstones, such as rings, necklaces, bracelets, and earrings. A formal term for jewelry as a product category.

examples.japanese: {宝飾品|ほうしょくひん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{宝飾品|ほうしょくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Luxury jewelry brands are lined up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}いだ→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧{宝飾品|ほうしょくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I treasure the jewelry I inherited from my grandmother.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{宝飾|ほうしょく}→宝飾：24299_houshoku⟧ (jewelry/ornamentation with gems) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item/product). A somewhat formal and commercial term, commonly used in department stores, advertisements, and industry contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦アクセサリー→アクセサリー：01761_akusesarii⟧ is more common for casual accessories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宝飾品|ほうしょくひん}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: jewelry store
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{宝飾品|ほうしょくひん}: luxury jewelry
- {宝飾品|ほうしょくひん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: jewelry counter/department
- {宝飾品|ほうしょくひん}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧: jewelry manufacturer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アクセサリー→アクセサリー：01761_akusesarii⟧: accessories — broader, includes costume jewelry
- ⟦{装身具|そうしんぐ}→装身具：24234_soushingu⟧: personal ornaments — formal/literary term
- ⟦ジュエリー→ジュエリー：25591_juerii⟧: jewelry — English loanword, commonly used
- ⟦{貴金属|ききんぞく}→貴金属：17138_kikinzoku⟧: precious metals — the material, not the finished product
